newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Klima sees Austria budget ready in July.
newsitem.headline: Klima sees Austria budget ready in July.

text.p: The Austrian government will complete negotiations on the 1998 budget by the end of July and the finance minister will make his budget speech to parliament in September, Chancellor Viktor Klima said on Tuesday.

Klima told journalists after a cabinet meeting that the 1999 budget would be settled by the middle of next year. Austria takes on the rotating presidency of the European Union in the second half of 1998.

"We will have to have the budget for 1999 signed and sealed before the middle of 1998 in consideration of Austria's presidency of the European Union," Klima said, so as to avoid the presidency being burdened by political wrangling.
The budgets for 1996 and 1997 had been hammered out between the Social Democrats and their junior coalition partner conservative People's Party.
Klima, head of the Social Democrats, gave no further details on the foundation for the 1998 and 1999 budgets. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 254
